_comment: Source of truth for MCP tool names that flawpilot skills may reference. Names under `tools` were verified against a live authenticated tools/list from https://mcp.flawpilot.com/mcp (server flawpilot-mcp-server 1.8.10) on 2026-10-12. Names in `unverified` come from the docs (https://docs.flawpilot.com/mcp-connect, 2026-11-16) and have not been seen in a live tools/list yet; `validate_skills.py --release` fails until they are verified and moved into `tools`.
